I am an old man now, 68 years, and my small plot here in Thyolo is only about half an acre where I grow my beans together with maize between them. I do not have much money for the chemical fertilizer, and anyway beans do not need it so much because they feed the soil themselves — I save the little fertilizer I can buy for the maize plot. I use the manure from my goats and chickens on this plot, and I keep my own bean seeds from last harvest like my father taught me. My sons help me sometimes, but my back is not strong, so for weeding I may call one or two young men from the village to help me for a few days.
